description:
Where a supplier's quote sits in the MEASURED customs-value band (HMRC
unit values, last twelve months) for one six-digit code and origin.

`hs6` and `origin` (country) are required. `quote` is GBP per unit;
`unit_mass_kg` converts it to GBP per kilogram, the band's unit. Only GBP
quotes are placed (`currency` unset or `"GBP"`). A customs unit value
averages many shipments, so `placement` says where the quote sits in the
band, not whether it is overpriced. `band.available: false` with
`band.reason` when no band is measured for that code and origin.

Figures carry a `provenance` stamp (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY or ESTIMATED; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names any figure only the caller holds. Information, not advice.
name: quote_check
title: Check a quote
